### Spec Kitty 4.0.0rc8

This is the eighth release candidate for 4.0.0. The notes below are organized by reader; the full list of changes follows in the changelog.

#### Upgrading from rc7

1. Install rc8, then run `spec-kitty upgrade` in each project and commit the result in the repository root checkout. Everyone who works on an upgraded project needs rc8 or later: an older CLI does not read the new activation file, so it puts every charter artifact in force and ignores deactivations (#6496).
2. Notable migrations that `upgrade` runs:
   - `4.0.0rc8_activation_ledger` moves charter activation keys from `charter.yaml` / `config.yaml` into `.kittify/charter/activation.yaml`. If two copies of a key disagree, it refuses and names both files (#6496).
   - Command skills are renamed from `spec-kitty.<command>` to `spec-kitty-<command>` so every Agent Skills harness loads them (#6475). Antigravity's old `.agent/workflows/` files are archived, not deleted (#6470).
   - `4.0.0rc8_lane_checkout_status_exclusion` keeps status files out of existing lane worktrees. A lane reported as `refused_lane_only_events` needs its transitions recorded with `move-task` first (#7281).
   - `4.0.0rc8_backfill_merged_at` stamps `merged_at` on Missions merged before that marker existed, and names every Mission it leaves alone (#7433).
   - Stale documentation and research templates, and the mission overrides the 2.0.6 sweep created, are repaired. A copy you edited is kept and named in a warning (#5280, #6922).
3. A second `spec-kitty upgrade` no longer deletes the generated `.claude/commands` files the first one kept (#7429, fixed by #7470).

#### If you run Missions day to day

- A new Mission starts on one topic branch, and its topology is settled by size at the first `finalize-tasks`. Missions created earlier, or with `--topology`, keep theirs (#7282).
- Landing is stricter. At `done`, every `in-mission` issue-matrix row needs a verdict: record it with `spec-kitty agent issue-verdict` (#6653). An approved work package needs a committed implementation and an independent review on every topology (#6715). A merge on a lane that adds content of its own must be reviewed before `consolidate` lands it (#7307).
- In-flight `single_branch` Missions may refuse with `APPROVAL_STAMP_MISSING`. Attest with `spec-kitty consolidate --attest-approved-reviewed <WP> --attest-reason "<why>"`, or move the work package back and approve it again (#7283).
- `spec-kitty upgrade` no longer commits into non-Mission worktrees you did not name. Use `--include-worktree PATH` or `--all-worktrees` (#7173).
- New: `spec-kitty doctor event-logs` previews and prunes old run journals and caches (#6610), and `spec-kitty doctor workspaces --prune` removes worktrees whose work has landed (#7173).

#### If you script against the CLI or orchestrator-api

- `charter status --json` and every owned-checkout refusal in `--json` mode now print `{"ok": false, "error": {"code": ..., "message": ...}}`. Read `error.code` and `error.message` (#6557, #6353). orchestrator-api moves to contract `1.20.0` for the owned refusals (#6353).
- A caller-supplied `--actor migration:...` is refused. Pass the live identity instead (#6754).
- `events tail` prints plain text by default. Pass `--json` to keep the previous machine output, byte for byte (#6611).
- `doctor mission-state --teamspace-dry-run` is removed (#7389).
- Integrators that register status fan-out handlers: the `*_saas_fanout*` names and `SPEC_KITTY_SAAS_FANOUT_TIMEOUT` are renamed to transport-neutral names, with no aliases (#6607).

#### If you author or manage charter packs

- `charter deactivate` records an exclusion that lasts, and the activation cascade stops at a deactivated artifact unless you pass `--include-deactivated` (#6496).
- `charter activate --preset <name> --force` now also clears exclusions the preset lists. Leave out `--force` to keep your deactivations (#6496).
- `NoActivationRestrictionsError` is removed. Catch `DeactivationRefused` (#6496).
- `spec-kitty charter org add` / `remove` register an org Charter Pack with a project (#7053).

#### Full changelog

Every change in this release, with its issue and PR numbers, is in the [4.0.0rc8 section of CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/spec-kitty/spec-kitty/blob/v4.0.0rc8/docs/changelog/CHANGELOG.md#400rc8---2026-11-09).
